messages:
elaine: Postmortem published for the 03/21 cross-tenant latency spike -> https://redwood.internal/postmortems/incident-2026-03-21-routing-misconfig . TL;DR: a rollout change to the routing table dropped a model-compatibility flag; ~5% of requests hit a variant with incompatible KV cache keys, which caused elevated p95/p99 for ~18 mins. RCA, timeline, mitigations, and action items are in the doc.

oncall-bot: Incident incident-2026-03-21 marked RESOLVED by elaine. Pager cleared at 2026-03-21T22:42:10Z.

mike: Thanks for publishing. Quick ask — can you call out the customer-impacted tenants in the summary so PM/customer-ops can triage comms? :pray:

elaine: Good call. Added a short "customer impact" section and a list of affected tenant IDs. No data exfil, just latency.

sandeep: Assigned: I'll own the routing validation fix and rollout guardrail. ETA: staging patch by 03/24, prod rollout 03/26 pending signoff. I'll post PR link shortly. :hammer_and_wrench:

jess: I'll add a synthetic test to the e2e suite to detect model-variant KV-key mismatches. Plan: new test + CI job that runs on routing changes. ETA: 03/25.

product-ops: Can we get a 1-paragraph customer-facing blurb we can use for emails/support?

mike: Draft suggestion: "We experienced a temporary increase in response latency for a small subset of requests due to an internal routing rollout. The issue has been resolved and we have deployed additional validations to prevent recurrence." Fine to tweak.

elaine: Great. Action items in the doc (owner/ETA/checkpoint). Follow-up checkpoints: 03/25 engineering sync to review test coverage, 03/26 post-deploy validation window. Owners please update your item rows with PR/links by EOD tomorrow.

sandeep: Noted — will link PR and rollout plan later today.

jess: Will add the test and CI job description to the doc, marking owner as me.

elaine: Also: immediate mitigations we applied (brief):
- reverted faulty routing rule (2026-03-21T22:25Z)
- temporary whitelist fallback to stable model family for high-qps tenants
- increased KV cache instrumentation for faster detection

elaine: If anyone sees anything missing from the action list that should be an owner, ping me or edit the doc. We'll keep this thread for quick status updates until the 03/26 validation completes. :white_check_mark:
